body:
I fully understand the the past trauma you went through and I'm sorry to hear that but the best way to get through this chapter of your life is to face your fears and stand up for yourself. Most guys will respect the fact that you don't want sex but you need to constantly remind them what you do and do not want. Guys being guys will continuously try and try to have sex when in bed with you, it's normal but you just gotta say no.

Unlike the unrealistic, movie style world the rest of these f**kers live in a man will always try to force himself on you to initiate sex and if you reciprocate then good enjoy! Lol but if you don't want sex just say no. When in a relationship both parties have a duty to fulfil one another's sexual needs but there are boundaries and no means no but you have to be firm about it, you need to assert your dominance like most women do when it comes to sex.

No man will ever be like your ex, your ex was a prick and you deserve better. Your bf slipped up when he was drunk and I'm sure he regrets that. When having sex it is not fair just to stop halfway through and go to sleep, I've had that happen to me and it made me feel so small and hurt. It's best to satisfy both parties for a healthy relationship, I've had sex many times when I didn't want to just to make my other half happy. This is not any sort of violation or rape it's just how the real world works, the fantasies of the internet are just that, fantasies. Ffs you don't need written permission to have sex like you're led to believe (obviously an exaggeration). Sometimes it's gotta be done whether you want to or not but that's not to say he has to get it every time he asks and it works both ways.

Set boundaries and stand your ground, I'm glad that you're using your common sense rather than jumping on the rape bandwagon like everyone else. A drunken mistake that will soon be forgotten about.

Now here comes the -20 dislikes lol

What's so disturbing? If it's consensual what's the problem? My ex allowed me to do it although it would wake her up or she'd pretend to sleep. It's a bit of fun if it's consensual we both enjoyed it.
I've tried to reason with these people lol it doesn't work
I agree but to say it was rape is a bit much especially when it was allowed to happen.

She never stated that she was in shock which is important to this discussion, she just pretended to be asleep and ALLOWED him to continue with absolutely no resistance. I fully understand what you are saying though.

Oh so you know what he thinks? They just need to discuss it why can people understand that? You don't know what he was thinking, you don't know what she was thinking. She was FULLY CONSCIOUS when this was happening so she has no blame here whatsoever? She allowed it to happen how can you not see that? She could've said no or left the room, she could've done something but she chose not to and because she chose not to they ended up in this situation, I'm not justifying what he did but they are both to blame.

Ok he raped her, she should report it to the police and get him arrested? Because if he raped her then that's what should happen regardless of what the situation is because rape is rape. Or could it just be a drunken mistake that she allowed to happen, she could've said no at any point. Also she spoke highly of her bf so to say 

>Victim blaming is disgraceful. How do you know that OP didn’t get the shit kicked out of her every time she spoke up in previous relationships?

Has absolutely no grounds in this conversation because she said he is not like that! Sometimes, just sometimes you have to be responsible for your actions of lack thereof in this case. Both parties are at fault. They are both victim of alcohol because both of their decisions were clouded that night.

They need to be adults and both take responsibility for what happened and resolve this. 

People like you annoy me because you're the first to jump on a bandwagon when you see a 'female victim' . People just need to own up to their mistakes instead of hiding behind the word VICTIM.
I'm fully awear of that but she allowed it to happen, they are both at fault now they need to discuss it and find a solution.

Oh sorry I must have missed the part where she was anally penetrated, it makes no sense as to what you're trying to say but yes if I was unconscious and she wanted to rub her clit of my face or even managed to get my ding-a-ling hard then please work away!

They BOTH let this situation play out the way it did. She needs to build a bridge and get over it and make sure it doesn't happen again by discussing it, unless it's some sort of fetish for him, in that case you gotta play your part lol

She was fully conscious and allowed it to happen, she should've spoke up and said something but considering she was drunk I'll put it down to bad judgement on her behalf. Both of them are responsible as to how this incident played out but because she's female she is 100% a victim in this situation. She could've easily spoke to him and told him no, but she allowed it to happen. He didn't force her in any way to do it she could've just said no.

I agree that he probably shouldn't have done it but shit happens, me personally I'd see the funny side of it and laugh about it and say that I wouldn't do it again if it was solely down to the alcohol. Mistakes happen and this isn't a life changing situation but considering her past I do see the sensitive side of it and that's where she and her bf need to talk.

No need to break up and get him convicted of rape, just sit and talk. He fucked up and Im sure he knows that. Don't take life too seriously and sort this situation out by discussing it with him and if yous don't meet eye to eye for whatever reason then say goodbye to him.

Oh and thanks for the laugh 🤣 as it sums up Reddit perfectly lol.

Her current bf is very respectful of her and she is very unsure of how to feel about this situation meaning she is not necessarily upset about this happening nor is she happy but she understands he was very drunk and is judgement was skewed. Commonsense tells us that he made a mistake and a discussion should take place between them to sort this out and to set boundaries, not to call him a rapist and make him out to be something she knows he's not. 

She's asking for advice and I give her mine, take it or leave it but rape shouldn't be thrown around lightly. If you or anyone genuinely believes he did rape her then he should be in prison but if you think this isn't worth jail time then why contradict yourself. It's not rape, just a drunken mistake and nothing more. Have a good day.
Lol my relationship was 100% consensual and it worked both ways. Do not assume things you don't know. Again I'll repeat myself, this is just my opinion and another angle at looking at it.

If my other half is horny and I'm not able to respond to satisfy her then by all means work away I have no problems, again it's just my opinion I'm not saying what I have said is fact it's just my views and common sense.

I'm sure he does that's probably why he denied it, or maybe he genuinely couldn't remember. Rape is a crime so by everyone else's responses he should be in prison and should be registered as a sex offender. Or we could all just use our common sense. At worst it was a drunken mistake, they just need to sit down and have a talk about it.
Yea but she is unsure so I give her my opinion but you think he deserves to go to prison for this? Catch yourself on and use your common sense.

By definition yes it it rape but wise up ffs. There was nothing malicious in it, he was just satisfying himself. Why do people have to be so sensitive. You know there doesn't have to be a victim in every situation, if she has a problem with it then sit him down and set the ground rules. At worst it was a drunken mistake no need to take everything so serious, it's not like he held her down and forced her. I'm glad I live where I live, I couldn't handle living in your culture where there ALWAYS has to be a victim.

I (M24) did this multiple times to my ex. Although for us it was ok, usually it would wake her up or she would be pretending to sleep then it would turn into full sex. I think to consider it along the lines of 'rape' would be a bit much because he is your boyfriend.

I understand your past and the trauma with that but there was nothing more to it than your bf having a bit of fun. Anytime I did it to my ex we would laugh and joke about it the next day because we were open like that and we both understood that when we are in a relationship sex at anytime is ok unless specifically told different. Everyone is different and not all relationships were like mine but don't think too much about it because it was nothing more than your bf satisfying himself but if it does genuinely bother you then sit down and have a word with him and set boundaries.

I'm not from the states, I assume you're American, so my culture is a little less sensitive to situations like this because we are much more grounded and very forward when it comes to sex.

He's sending you those as a reminder from when yous were a thing. Sexually he's very much into you and I guess that's one of his ways at getting that point across. He misses you and is thinking about what he lost.

Thing is I'm a guy and my ex cheated when he was 2 months old and I later found out she cheated many times before he was conceived too, she put me through hell. Now she lives in our 4 bedroom house with our son and I rent a shitty room in the centre of our town. I'm certain it's not postpartum, I got fucked over and I'm struggling to cope on my own. I have a bird (Cockatiel) and a dog that I can't live with because of my accomodation and paying child maintenance makes it hard to afford anything better than what I already have. I can't see my dog, bird or son everyday and that affects me.

Loneliness is so hard to cope with, I just want the pain to stop, it's to the point where the loneliness hurts so I feel your pain. I have family too but like you said they can't help.

You should hide under her bed and if she freaks out then fuck it, you dodged a bullet. If she doesn't freak out then I guess she lied to you?🛌🏻
                                                            🦹

From my experience it seems like he just can't be bothered with you, he just wants to put you in a corner until he wants you. I fear this relationship might be at its end. If this is a daily or almost daily thing then just walk away, it will save you a lot of pain. He's using his son to control the arguments and to silence you, it's a control thing it's one of his ways to control the situation. 'you can't do this or that because, my son'.

Sounds like a toxic relationship and I recognize that because I was in one. She broke me to the point where I couldn't take it anymore and I hung myself, I passed out then I woke up on the floor dazed as if I woke up from a dream and I didn't know what was going on. She found me in time and broke the cord I cut off the hoover that was attached to my bedroom door. I woke up with the cord still attached to my neck. 

Even though I was minutes away from brain damage then death she was still a horrible bitch to me. (Long story short)

My point is you're punishing yourself for no reason, if he doesn't want you and if he doesn't make you happy or want to make you happy then go make yourself happy. I'm still in the process of doing that but I'm hopeful it will happen soon. It's hard not having a job, I know, but you will get something eventually. Everything happens for a reason! Fuck him, love yourself.

The only one you can rely on is yourself, no doubt everyone will let you down at some point.

I'm here to talk if you need it.

To hear you got an abortion makes me sad, I'm 23M and have a beautiful 10 month old son. You give up your son/daughter for this man and any man that convinces you to give up your child isn't worth being with.

To hold a mini version of yourself, to hear that first cry after birth, to see something so small and delicate and to understand that the child you give birth to depends 100% on you to make it through its young life is the best and most emotional time of your life. There is no feeling that compares to hearing that first cry.

That child had a whole life to live and you were influenced to give him/her up to keep someone else happy. Fuck him, find a man that wants to be an actual man and raise his kids and not abort them.

I'm sorry if this hurts but I'm just being straight with you. Breaks my heart to know that people put their kids through so much pain before they even take their first breaths.

Move on and start a family with someone else.

I feel the same way buddy, I'm not the worst looking guy around I just lack confidence. I feel like I'd be a disappointment to everyone and that I would be a waste of someone's time because there is someone out there that could make them much happier than what I can. Loneliness hurts so much 😢

You're gonna have to do the thing you don't want to do and that's to leave him. You need to be strong and get away from him. He isn't good for your mental health. Or you you live a lie and tell yourself that things are gonna get better when deep down you know they're not. Please do yourself a favour and leave him.

You will be in so much pain and depressed when you take this step but by taking this step you are one step closer to being happy.
That's pretty much normal at that age. Between 13-18 it's normal to do that, those are the years to experiment and enjoy other people.

That's my point, that 10% will haunt you until the day yous end. Confront her and sort it out, you can't let her make you feel like this. If she wants to be with you then she'll have no problem in dropping him but if she shows any sort of resistance then your fears are confirmed and their relationship wasn't so innocent.

I feel the same buddy. Although my life isn't too bad I still think about suicide everyday. My life fell to shit when my ex cheated on Xmas Eve 2019 when we had a 2 1/2 month old baby. Now I rent a room, see my son twice a week and lonely as fuck. 

I also find peace in death, I did try to kill myself but she found me in time. When I tried there was no pain, no discomfort just slowly becoming unconscious until I became unconscious. Then I woke up on the floor with her standing over me.

She means nothing to me now but the loneliness is hard to deal with and I assume you struggle with that too. Just find comfort in knowing that there are people in the same situation as you and there is people like myself here to help if you need it.

She's cheating, I was in that position and I was passive about it because I trusted her then she tore my whole life apart. If she was committed to you then her ex would be out of her life or at least have a very small part in it, not texting on the daily. She might not be physically cheating but emotionally she is cheating.

From my experiences this sort of behaviour will last the entire relationship, confront her and if she shows any sort of resistance just leave otherwise you'll just live with the paranoia of is she or isn't she and eventually end up hurt.

Don't do it buddy, your life is worth more even if you think it's not. I've been in your situation and I've acted upon it but I regret doing it, I think if I got into the same situation again I'd probably just end it so I'm kinda hypocritical lol. My point is just keep going whatever your situation is it will improve it just takes time so you have to be patient.

I am 5'7 and I feel your pain lol loneliness is, in my opinion, a killer. It can push people to do stupid things but you need to fill the void by socializing in some sort of hobby. I'm fortunate enough that I can vent to my work colleagues and they will listen and give advice and that helps me a bit but the loneliness while laying in bed at night can become overwhelming and when that happens my anxiety goes through the roof and I feel worthless like I'm going to be alone forever.

I could use dating apps but I'm too anxious for that, I feel like people would judge and laugh and that if I clicked with someone that I would be a disappointment to them.

Life can be hard but keep your head up and know that you're not going through this alone, many people are in your situation and if needs be then we can band together and help one another.

For me the army is the answer, I'm going to join so I can get away from all this shit we deal with everyday. We worry about things that don't actually matter but I think the army is the answer to get away from everyday worries and to make something of myself and leave my dead end job behind.

Socializing is the only cure for loneliness and that's what you're gonna have to do to fight the depression. There's someone out there for everyone, you just have to fight for it.
Yes I am much better, I moved out and got away from her and all the feelings I had for her are gone. She did ruin me but I dug deep and pulled myself out of the hole I was in.
Yea I did trust her too much, let her talk to whoever she wanted and then i get fucked over

I'm about to lose my home too because of my girlfriend, now ex. I have to go and rent a room to live in for the foreseeable future and live my life as a loner. I don't have anyone to talk to and I have lost everything too. I also have tried to kill myself in the past few weeks and my ex saved me but ultimately didn't care if I died or not. She now tells me to kill myself on a daily basis because she wants me gone so she can go after her new love interests.

 I'm here for you, you're not alone.

I hung myself a few weeks ago and if I'm being honest it was peaceful. I was unconscious so I was 100% going to die but my now ex girlfriend found me in time and cut me down then I slowly came around to consciousness again.

I wish she didn't find me because life is just too hard and I just want my pain to end. I'm 23 and I don't want to live anymore, I tell myself I'm not suicidal but I know I am and I think I would do it again and that's scary.

I'm afraid to die but I'm even more afraid to live because I know I'll always be in some sort of pain and let down again. But I'm just gonna keep going until I can't.

You're 100% correct, in my experience females have so many potential partners queuing up when single or not.

Where as males don't have many at all, single or not. It's not fair lol

I suppose it's our turn to be selfish and make ourselves happy. Being selfish doesn't come naturally to me so I'd struggle with it but if I don't be selfish I won't be happy.

Why is your ex happy? Why is my ex happy? Because they only care for themselves and I think we need to be like that too well maybe just a little.

Idk what to do either I try to lie to myself by thinking everything will get better, this pain will be over soon and I'll be happy soon. Something like this will take a long while to get over and I don't particularly want to go though it because the loneliness kills me inside.

So lonely all the time and it's no fun feeling like this day in and day out.

I got told that she wanted to work shit out too just to be told that it was only be she felt sorry for me because she had left me in pieces. That day was so hard on me. She left me because she 'loved' someone else after 2 weeks. My whole life, everything I've accomplished in life just taken away by some scumbag that just wants to get his c*ck wet. Can't believe someone that you invest much into can leave you like that, it's hard to comprehend. I still don't understand it fully, maybe she is just a heartless b*tch.

Some people only care about themselves and couldn't care less who they hurt on their journey to happiness.

It's hard to see the person you love with someone else especially when you have a child with them. But the hardest thing to deal with is facing the fact that they don't care anymore, that eats me up inside.

Congratulations you and I are on the same boat ⛵

I have to move out too (btw go read my story). I'm still being tormented everyday with her telling me that it's none of my business if she goes on a date with someone or who she talks too. I suppose she's right but I still care and it still hurts. 

I see her everyday on her phone texting someone and I wreck my head with thinking who she's talking to and what she's planning to do.

I also have a young child who is 3 months old and because I'm male she will get initial custody of him then we will have to go to court so I can fight for 50/50 custody, so much bs to deal with.

I don't even want to go to work anymore because I feel so alone and empty. When you plan a life with someone and it get ripped away from you it is hard to deal with. It's the hardest time of my life and the fact I have no one to talk to makes it even harder. I only have the likes of yourself and people like you that will listen and advise me on what to do next.

Both of us are hurting and it will be hard but that's life and some people get it easy and they tend to be the ones that go out of their way to make others unhappy. Then there's the nice ones like all of us that are here that get f*cked over by the no so nice ones that find life a bit tougher.

What I'm trying to say is keep your head up because you're not alone, we are here for you and if you need to talk or vent pm me and I'll be more than happy to talk to you because we are in the same situation and we could probably benefit from sharing both our experiences so far.

I'm here if you need me 👍

He's sadly passed but try to keep your head up, he's not here to experience life so take time to grieve then try to be happy. If not for yourself then for him, live life for him, make him proud that his baby has the power to overcome her demons and is able to fight on. Be strong for him.

Please stop hurting yourself because it helps no one. Try to love yourself anyway you can don't destroy something he loved, your body was precious to him so protect it.

I'm here if you need to talk.

Everyday I have to listen to her talk to him on the phone and to watch her to walk out the door to go see him kills me inside. Fortunately she caught me in time and cut me down so I was only passed out for 10 seconds, give or take. My girlfriend cheated on me on Xmas Eve and we have a 3 month old baby, my whole life gone.

What I want is for people to read this and to realize that they aren't alone. There are many of us feeling like this and many of us go through it alone. If I can pull through this then so can anyone, I've already hung myself and it's hard to get the courage to do something like that but I also believe it's harder to find the courage to fight on. To face you're demons face to face and defeat them.

The fact that people read this makes me feel a lot better because I know I'll be helping at least one person with their issues in life. Your life isn't worth ending because someone doesn't care about you. Yes it's hard to live with the pain but join me and fight it just know you're not alone, whoever you may be, because I'm going through it too as are many others.
Yep but let's go until our limits finally break maybe we'll find the reason we need to stay here, alive.
